facts.fact: CAFI Managing Director Chaba Mokuku said a Business Facilitation Single Window at the One Stop Business Facilitation Centre (OBFC), designed to simplify business registration and licensing, has been deployed and is to be launched by the end of 2025 or early 2026.

systems.owner: One Stop Business Facilitation Centre (OBFC), under CAFI / Ministry of Trade, Industry and Business Development
